mapper.select:
select booksetId, --产品代码 booksetName, --产品名称 startDate, --账套开始日 acctSubjectId, --核算主体代码 acctSubjectType, --核算主体类别 standardCcy, --本位币 taxStartDate, --缴税开始日 taxRefundStartDate, --退税开始日 interestIncome, --利息收入 dividendIncome, --红利收入 difbetIncome, --价差收入 SUM(interestIncome + dividendIncome + difbetIncome) as appreciationTax, --增值税 constructionTax, --城建税 educationTax, --教育费 placeeducationTax, --地方教育费 SUM(constructionTax + educationTax + placeeducationTax) as additionalTax from ( select bbs.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, bbs.BOOKSET_NAME as booksetName, bbs.START_DATE as startDate, bbs.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AS acctSubjectId, bbs.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE AS acctSubjectType, BBS.STANDARD_CCY AS standardCcy,
NVL( (select to_char(max(tpd.mdate+1),'yyyy-MM-dd') from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING bda on tpd.trade_id = bda.busi_no where bda.bookset_id = bbs.bookset_id and tpd.busi_type = '16' and tpd.mdate < to_date(#{payment1},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and tpd.trade_id not in ( select p_trade_id from trd_product_deal where p_trade_id is not null and trade_status = #{tradeStatus} )
and tpd.trade_status != #{tradeStatus}) ,to_char(fp.vdate,'yyyy-MM-dd')) as taxStartDate, (select to_char(max(tpd.vdate),'yyyy-MM-dd') from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING bda on tpd.trade_id = bda.busi_no where bda.bookset_id = bbs.bookset_id and tpd.busi_type = '16' and tpd.mdate = to_date(#{payment1}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and tpd.trade_id not in ( select p_trade_id from trd_product_deal where p_trade_id is not null and trade_status = #{tradeStatus} )
and tpd.trade_status != #{tradeStatus}) as taxRefundStartDate, nvl((select bba.o_c_amt - bba.o_d_amt from BOK_BALANCE bba where bbs.bookset_id = bba.bookset_id and bbs.standard_ccy = bba.o_ccy and bba.balance_date = to_date(#{payment1}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and bba.subject_no = '22210801'),0) as interestIncome, nvl((select bba.o_c_amt - bba.o_d_amt from BOK_BALANCE bba where bbs.bookset_id = bba.bookset_id and bbs.standard_ccy = bba.o_ccy and bba.balance_date = to_date(#{payment1}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and bba.subject_no = '22210802'),0) as dividendIncome, nvl((select bba.o_c_amt - bba.o_d_amt from BOK_BALANCE bba where bbs.bookset_id = bba.bookset_id and bbs.standard_ccy = bba.o_ccy and bba.balance_date = to_date(#{payment1}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and bba.subject_no = '22210803'),0) as difbetIncome, nvl((select bba.o_c_amt - bba.o_d_amt from BOK_BALANCE bba where bbs.bookset_id = bba.bookset_id and bbs.standard_ccy = bba.o_ccy and bba.balance_date = to_date(#{payment1}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and bba.subject_no = '22210101'),0) as constructionTax, nvl((select bba.o_c_amt - bba.o_d_amt from BOK_BALANCE bba where bbs.bookset_id = bba.bookset_id and bbs.standard_ccy = bba.o_ccy and bba.balance_date = to_date(#{payment1}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and bba.subject_no = '22210102'),0) as educationTax, nvl((select bba.o_c_amt - bba.o_d_amt from BOK_BALANCE bba where bbs.bookset_id = bba.bookset_id and bbs.standard_ccy = bba.o_ccy and bba.balance_date = to_date(#{payment1}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and bba.subject_no = '22210103'),0) as placeeducationTax from BOK_BOOKSET bbs
left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = bbs.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and fp.FINPROD_TYPE = bbs.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE where 1=1
AND bbs.BOOKSET_ID IN
#{booksetId}
)
where (interestIncome != 0 OR dividendIncome!= 0 OR difbetIncome!= 0)
AND taxRefundStartDate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY booksetId, booksetName, startDate, acctSubjectId, acctSubjectType, standardCcy, taxStartDate, taxRefundStartDate, interestIncome, dividendIncome, difbetIncome, constructionTax, educationTax, placeeducationTax

select bbs.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId from BOK_BOOKSET bbs left join BOK_BOOKSET_DATE BBD on BBD.BOOKSET_ID = bbs.BOOKSET_ID where 1=1
AND BBD.BOOKSET_ID IN
#{booksetId}
and BBD.BOOKSET_DATE > to_date(#{payment2}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
